Bug_Title: SING: Instance-getter method of class using singleton design pattern is not synchronized. (SING_SINGLETON_GETTER_NOT_SYNCHRONIZED)
Bug_Details:
Instance-getter method of class using singleton design pattern is not synchronized. When this method is invoked by two or more threads simultaneously,
multiple instantiation of a singleton class becomes possible.
SEI CERT MSC07-J rule
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the getInstance() method of the SingletonExample class. The method is not synchronized, which means that if multiple threads call this method simultaneously, it can lead to the creation of multiple instances of the SingletonExample class.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the unsynchronized getInstance() method multiple times concurrently through the showBug method, which uses an ExecutorService to create multiple threads.
